d: Short, shaggy platinum white hair with uneven bangs and a petite, youthful face with wide, bright lime-green eyes. The build is slender and small, wearing a dark olive-green sailor-style jacket with tan fur trim on the cuffs, a white blouse with a red bow, and a matching dark olive-green pleated skirt over opaque white tights and black Mary Jane shoes. The design features metallic grey ship-hull rigging with gun turrets floating beside the hips, and grey mechanical ankle shackles.
